E1346

Callable CLI members cannot be declared on a Codable struct

What

Callable CLI members cannot be declared on a Codable struct

Why

CLI commands are behavior; Codable structs contain only serializable data fields.

Fix

Split the command program struct from the Codable data struct

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E1346: tests/ui/cli_program_codable_member.stderr.

Error [E1346]: callable CLI members cannot be declared on a Codable struct
  --> tests/ui/cli_program_codable_member.jet:2:8
    |
  2 | struct Commands {
    |        ^^^^^^^^
 Why: CLI commands are behavior, while Codable structs contain only serializable data fields.
 Fix: split the command program struct from the Codable data struct
